visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with her hair in a ponytail and wearing a white sweater enters a brightly lit Disney store through white double doors. The setting is vibrant with red carpeting and wood-paneled shelving displaying various plush toys. (2) The camera transitions into a series of fast-paced close-up shots showing various 2025 Christmas-themed merchandise. This includes Mickey Mouse 'Lil RingRing' elf plushies, LinaBell plushies holding miniature Christmas trees, and various Disney character headbands. The lighting is warm and bright, typical of a retail display. (3) The scene shifts to the exterior of Tokyo Disneyland during a clear day. The woman is seen from behind, wearing a festive headband and looking towards the iconic castle and a crowded plaza. A parade float with Mickey and friends passes by, decorated with garlands and ornaments. (4) The visuals return to product highlights, showing detailed shots of popcorn buckets shaped like Christmas trees and various snack containers. The woman is then seen interacting with a cast member at an outdoor stall, receiving a popcorn bucket. (5) The final phase shows the woman back in an indoor setting, posing with a Mickey elf figure. Large text overlays dominate the screen with a holiday theme.
